The physical_scope instead says the positive-measure set lies “in the declared action cube.” The measured set here consists of frequency labels; the item defines no action cube and makes no positive-measure claim about one.

The proof calls the rescaling canonical while computing dθ_i∧dΠ_i = J_0 dθ_i∧dI_i. The dependency def-cm13-canonical-map.md defines a canonical map by the exact condition C*ω₂ = ω₁. For the general allowed positive parameters, this rescaling gives a non-unit factor, so it is conformally symplectic rather than canonical under that definition. The time-rescaled Hamilton equations may still correspond as shown, but that does not establish canonicity.
